name: muenchen-zwilling
description: A 1:1 3D twin of Munich city centre and Munich Airport with live open-data layers.

template.name: muenchen-zwilling
template.description: Munich city centre and airport as one 1:1 3D twin with live open-data layers, a tool-calling assistant and shared coordination notes.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && node tools/check-assets.mjs && vite build && node tools/check-assets.mjs --bundle
scripts.test: node --test tests/map.test.mjs tests/geo.test.mjs tests/world.test.mjs tests/relay.test.mjs tests/luft.test.mjs tests/fahrplan.test.mjs
